title: Local edge-connectivity augmentation of a hypergraph with fixed rank

statement.text:
We are given a hypergraph <math>G_0=(V,\mathcal{E}_0)</math> of rank at most <math>k</math> (where
<math>k</math> is fixed, not part of the input) and a symmetric function
<math>r:V\times V\to \mathbb{Z}_+</math>. Can we find in polynomial time a graph <math>G=(V,{E})</math> with a minimum
number of edges such that <math>\lambda_{G_0+G}(x,y)\ge r(x,y)</math> for every
<math>x,y\in V</math>?
